d: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah paid floral tribute to Mahatma Gandhi at Raj Ghat in New Delhi on November 23 during his first visit to India since assuming office in March 2026. In a message in the memorial's visitor book, Shah praised Gandhi's ideals of truth, compassion and selfless service, describing compassion as “the ultimate strength”. He also reaffirmed Nepal's commitment to strengthening its longstanding friendship with India ahead of bilateral talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
